scale-reading
info:
Reusable example subflow.

Multiplies an incoming numeric reading by SCALE and adds OFFSET.
SCALE and OFFSET are environment variables declared on the definition
and overridden per instance, so every instance shares one body of
logic while remaining individually configurable.

name: scale + offset

label: Subflow Example

Two instances of the single scale-reading definition, each with its
own SCALE/OFFSET. Editing the definition changes both; the env vars
keep their calibration distinct.
